notes: Formulation B: independent re-phrasing of the ten F10A meaning units in both languages (same events, same order, same name Anton). Replacements include sails across the strait at dawn/crosses the strait at first light (segelt über/überquert, Morgengrauen/erstes Tageslicht), the wind blows from the north/a stiff breeze comes out of the north (Wind weht/steife Brise kommt), waves strike the hull with great force/heavy waves pound the hull again and again (schlagen gegen/hämmern gegen), holds the wheel/grips the wheel firmly (hält das Steuerrad/umklammert das Steuer), fishing boat crosses his course/small trawler cuts across his course (Fischerboot kreuzt an Steuerbord/Fischkutter quert an der Steuerbordseite), lighthouse appears/comes into view (erscheint/wird sichtbar), seagull follows the boat/gull accompanies the vessel (folgt/begleitet), checks the sails every few minutes/inspects the sails at short intervals (prüft/kontrolliert), current pushes the boat to the south/pulls the boat towards the south (treibt nach Süden/zieht in Richtung Süden), reaches the harbour before sunset/steers the boat into the harbour before dusk (erreicht den Hafen/steuert das Boot in den Hafen). 'überquert', 'umklammert' and 'begleitet' are inseparable; no separable verbs are used. Present tense and positive polarity throughout.
